tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Plastic Pollution- Ban Single-use Plastics vs Improve Recycling
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: We've been discussing the impact of plastic waste on the environment. Plastic pollution is a significant issue affecting marine life and ecosystems. Some experts suggest banning single-use plastics as a solution, while others believe that improving recycling efforts is more effective. What do you think is the best way to address plastic pollution?

posts.name: Kelly
posts.text: Banning single-use plastics is the best solution. It would drastically reduce the amount of plastic waste generated and force industries to develop more sustainable alternatives. This approach tackles the issue at its source. We can't rely on the recycling industry to solve a problem it is already struggling to address.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: Improving recycling efforts is a better solution. By enhancing recycling technologies and encouraging proper waste management, we can reduce plastic pollution without disrupting industries or consumer habits. Recycling offers a more practical approach.
